---
title: "SARS-CoV-2 WHO Situation Reports, 2019–2020"
---

## Overview

This dataset contains information manually transcribed from the World Health Organization (WHO) Situation Reports on SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) during the early phase of the pandemic. Each row corresponds to a single WHO Situation Report. Data availability varies across reports as reporting formats evolved over time.

## Source

WHO Situation Reports: <https://www.who.int/emergencies/diseases/novel-coronavirus-2019/situation-reports>

## Loading the data

```{julia}
using Outbreaks
using DataFrames
df = Outbreaks.sarscov2_who_2019()
```

## First few rows

```{julia}
first(df, 6)
```
